story.title: More than twenty-four years of carrying the goods that keep Zambia moving.
story.lead: Panafrica Distributors Limited (PAD Ltd) is a Zambian-registered distributor of fast-moving consumer goods, established over 24 years ago and owned by Hon. Suresh M. Desai and Rajen Desai, both Zambian citizens. It is not a conventional wholesaler, but a specialist in the last mile.
story.body: We operate out of a 3,000 m² warehouse and office facility at Plot 20108, Mumbwa Road, Chinika Area, Lusaka, supported by branches in Monze (1,000 m²) and Livingstone (2,000 m²). Our model is Direct Store Delivery: our own people, in our own vehicles, placing and replenishing stock on the shelf where it actually sells.
story.imageAlt: A deep warehouse aisle at Panafrica Distributors, shelving stacked with packaged fast-moving consumer goods under overhead lights.

network.title: Three depots. Four provinces. One last mile.
network.body: Our presence spans the Lusaka, Western, Eastern and Southern Provinces. Lusaka is the hub for the capital and Western Province, while Monze and Livingstone carry the Southern Province, with weekly routes into the towns and townships that national chains rarely reach.
network.imageAlt: A Panafrica Distributors delivery truck on the highway in Southern Province, Zambia, with dry bush and hills in the evening light.

map.title: Where the last mile reaches
map.intro: An indicative map of the network. Each route line is drawn hub by hub — Lusaka west to Mongu, east along the Great East Road through Petauke to Katete and Chipata, and south through Monze and Choma to Livingstone and the Kazungula border.
map.ariaLabel: Indicative map of Zambia showing Panafrica Distributors depots at Lusaka, Monze and Livingstone and distribution routes west to Mongu, south to Livingstone and east to Chipata.

legend.title: Coverage
legend.text: Lusaka, Western, Eastern and Southern provinces, with cross-border corridors at Kazungula and Chirundu.

brands.intro: Panafrica Distributors is an official distributor for its principals, servicing modern trade, wholesalers, supermarkets, large retailers, township shops, bars, clubs, restaurants and hotels.

people.name: Hon. Suresh M. Desai
people.bio: Over 50 years of experience in retail, wholesale trade and last-mile distribution. A former Member of Parliament and minister — Energy & Water Development, Works & Supply, Environment & Natural Resources, and Agriculture, Food & Fisheries. Currently Board Chairman of the Food Reserve Agency.

people.name: Nainan Mathews
people.bio: An honours BSc in Agriculture with 37+ years in management — 13 years in distribution and marketing of agricultural products and 24 years in FMCG marketing.

people.name: Rajen Desai
people.bio: A Master’s in Management from the University of Derby (UK) with 20+ years of experience in retail, wholesale and last-mile distribution.

people.name: Thirumula Chary
people.bio: An MBA in Finance with 14+ years in banking and 10 years in management and information systems.

people.name: Sanjay Datta
people.bio: An MA in Economics and B.Com (Meerut University, India) with 30+ years in sales and marketing. Specialises in sales forecasting, stock planning, sub-distributor appointment, product launches and numeric distribution.

people.name: Greyson Foloshi
people.bio: A Bachelor of Business Administration with extensive sales and marketing experience in multinationals, including British American Tobacco.

people.name: Malawo Siakufweba
people.bio: 13+ years in accounting across transportation, manufacturing, auditing and trade. Holds the ATD accounting diploma and is pursuing ZICA certification.

people.name: Chrispin Mazuba
people.bio: Over 20 years in labour administration and human resources management across membership organisations, oil marketing, manufacturing, transport and distribution.

brandsPage.title: The brands we carry to the last shelf.
brandsPage.intro: Panafrica Distributors is an official distributor for seven principals, from tobacco and food to personal care, spirits and household goods. Each is served with the same discipline: our own people, our own vehicles, delivered direct to the outlet.

coveragePage.title: Four provinces. Weekly. On the shelf.
coveragePage.intro: From the Chinika Area head office in Lusaka and branches in Monze and Livingstone, we service about 8,000 outlets every week across the Lusaka, Western, Eastern and Southern Provinces — supermarkets and hotels in the city, bars, clubs and small shops in the townships.

contactPage.title: Talk to the team that runs the route.
contactPage.intro: Whether you are a brand looking for a last-mile distributor in Zambia or a customer with a question, write to us or call. We reply during working hours, usually within one business day.
contactPage.mission: Empowering Zambia with fast, reliable, customer-first distribution, bridging suppliers and consumers with premium products. We fuel sustainable growth for partners and communities, creating a stronger, more connected future.

why.title: Direct Store Delivery
why.body: Our own people in our own vehicles deliver straight to the outlet, which strengthens customer relationships and reliability.

why.title: Reach that is measured
why.body: About 8,036 outlets served every week across four provinces — modern trade, wholesalers, supermarkets, township shops, bars, clubs, restaurants and hotels.

why.title: People and fleet
why.body: 139 employees and more than 90 vehicles, from large trucks to small vans, adapt to any terrain and customer.

why.title: Integrity and compliance
